Title: Sanjay's Day

Cast

1. Sanjay - 31 years, prince, son
Look: golden crown, red royal robe
2. Kavita - 59 years, queen, mother
Look: small crown, pink lehenga
3. Ajay - 60 years, king, father
Look: golden crown, red royal robe

Places

1. The royal court - tall pillars, a golden throne
2. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window

Scene 1: The royal court - Day

[Sanjay stands in the court. Kavita and Ajay stand near him.]

Kavita: "Sanjay, what's the plan today?"

[Sanjay sits down on the throne.]

Sanjay (laughing): "Father, look at this."

[Sanjay unrolls the royal scroll and reads it aloud.]

Sanjay: "Careful!"

Scene 2: The living room - Day

[Sanjay stands in the living room. Kavita and Ajay stand near him.]

Ajay: "What a nice place."

[Sanjay sips red wine.]

Sanjay: "Slowly, take it easy."

[Sanjay walks slowly across the room while talking on the phone.]

Kavita: "Oh wow!"

[Sanjay nearly dies laughing at the joke.]

Sanjay (gently): "And then?"

[Sanjay's phone dies in the middle of the call.]

Ajay (softly): "Really?"

[The doorbell rings; Sanjay opens the door and takes the parcel.]

Sanjay: "I really enjoyed today."
